params.body:
On a test by question, the "Vragen" box above the sheet was capped at `max-w-3xl`. Over the matrix it stopped about halfway; over the per-pupil column it sat further in and was narrower than the column. Looking at it also showed that the two views never shared a left edge: the matrix and its controls had side padding of their own on top of the page's, so they began 32px further in than the per-pupil column.

## Change

- **The sheet holds the box.** `Edit`'s view now mounts `<livewire:scoring.evaluation.questions>` instead of the page. The view switches without a reload, so a box mounted by the page could never follow it.
- **One frame for both views.** The box, the sheet's controls and the sheet all start at the page's edge under the title; only the width differs: the whole width over the matrix, the pupil's column (`max-w-2xl lg:max-w-4xl`) per pupil.
- **The matrix loses its own side padding** (`px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8`), both the ordinary matrix and the one by question. This moves the ordinary matrix 32px to the left and makes it 64px wider for every teacher, not only on tests by question.
- **Same spacing in both views.** The box has the same room around it in both views (16px below it). Before, it had room above it over the matrix and below it per pupil.

## Tests

`ATestByQuestionOnScreenTest::the_questions_and_the_sheet_share_one_frame_in_both_views` checks four things:
- the sheet holds the box in both views, and the page shows it once;
- the box's frame and the controls' frame are the same in both views except for the column width, and they follow when the view switches;
- the box has no width of its own;
- neither matrix (by question or not) nor the controls carry side padding.

It fails on main.

Eight view mutations each turn it red:
- the box keeps its own cap
- the frame ignores the view
- more room above the box over the matrix
- the page holds the box as well
- the sheet does not hold the box
- the controls keep their matrix padding
- the matrix by question keeps its padding
- the ordinary matrix keeps its padding

`EvaluationScoresEditTest::the_matrix_is_not_on_offer_on_a_narrow_screen_and_says_so` checked the table wrapper's class list word for word; it now checks the list without the padding (still hidden below `sm`, a block from `sm`).

Measured in headless Chromium at 1400px and 900px, on a test by question and on an ordinary evaluation:
- the title stands at 288 (24 at 900px);
- box, controls, matrix and per-pupil column all start at 320 (48 at 900px);
- the box ends where the matrix ends (1336), or where the per-pupil column ends (1216).

Switching views and then adding or removing a question still redraws the sheet, with no console errors.

Full suite on the workbench: 1386 passed, 20 failed, 6 skipped. The same 20 fail on main there (build stamp, Chrome printing of reports). Rebased onto 4fabc553; #272 touches none of these files.
params.title: Give the questions box and both sheet views one frame
